observations.section: Violations of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act
observations.title: Incomplete laboratory control records and undocumented trial injections
observations.summary: FDA found that laboratory control records were missing data from many test results and that analysts performed numerous unexplained trial injections using the “Developer” role without adequate documentation or justification.

observations.section: Violations of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act
observations.title: Quality unit failure to control and retain original laboratory records
observations.summary: The Quality Unit did not ensure proper control, retention, and review of paper and electronic laboratory records, resulting in original documents being discarded in shred bins and reliance on photocopies for data verification.

observations.section: Violations of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act
observations.title: Inadequate controls over computerized systems and shared user credentials
observations.summary: Investigators observed that analysts shared usernames and passwords to access GMP computerized systems, a violation of data‑integrity principles, and the firm’s review did not cover all systems or the full time period.
